dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent elliptical 'O' structures exhibit thin, high-contrast light-grey perimeters. The transition from the dark exterior to the light perimeter is abrupt, with a similar sharp transition back to a dark interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, high-intensity white punctate spots concentrated primarily along the mid-lateral and dorsal regions, exhibiting no internal color gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal-lateral macro-annuli form an elongated scalene triangle relative to the longitudinal axis of the body.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, distinct, irregularly shaped reddish-brown patch with a desegmented, granular texture is present in the mid-lateral region, representing significant physical trauma or a lesion.
other_distinctive_markers: A complex, reticulated network of thin light-grey lines connects several annular structures across the central-lateral surface.
